A stone monument wreathed in blue soulfire, erected at your exact point of death when wearing an attuned §5Eternal Guardian's Band§r.

§6Preservation & Defense§r
• Holds all items from your hotbar, main inventory, armor, offhand, and Curios slots.
• Preserves 100% of your accumulated experience points without penalty.
• Broadcasts death coordinates to your chat so you can navigate back.
• Spawns an §cEternal Guardian§r to stand vigil against intruders until you return.

§6Reclaiming Your Gear§r
Right-click the tombstone to instantly restore every item to its original slot and absorb your saved experience. The guardian peacefully dismisses as the stone crumbles.
